title: Git dependency pinned to a short commit fragment
description: package.json declares a git dependency pinned to a commit fragment rather than a registry version. The commit is immutable but outside the registry, so no registry attestation, signature or advisory range covers the code that runs.
remediation: Prefer a published version; when a commit is unavoidable, review the diff at that sha and record why the registry cannot be used.
limitation: It matches a git dependency pinned to a commit fragment rather than a registry version in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
